This pavement is used by school children walking in groups and is an accident waiting to happen.

item.title: Risk to pedestrians on crossing, 13th August
item.description:
The zebra crossing is obscured by the overgrown shrubs,bushes and weeds along North Upton Lane in Hucclecote. The bend in the road causes obstruction which cannot be changed but can the vegetation be cut back beyond the edge of the road to give clearer sight of people either waiting to cross or crossing the road as you travel from Abbeymead to Hucclecote direction. See pictures for location.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): North Upton Lane, Hucclecote, Gloucester
